text:
Diego M: hey team — trying to finish k8s setup on day 2. i merged the shared kubeconfig and i can see multiple contexts but when i try to `kubectl auth can-i create deployments -n rl-data` i get a weird error about impersonation. any ideas?
Ben (DevEx): welcome Diego! what does `kubectl config current-context` show and what's the exact error message?
Diego M: current context is `redwood-dev` and the error is:
```
error: couldn't get rolebinding for user: User "diego@example.com" cannot be impersonated: users "diego@example.com" not found
```
Diego M: i did try `kubectl --as=system:serviceaccount:default:diego-sa get pods -n rl-data` which returns forbidden.
Priya R: quick note — we recommend not using `--as` unless you're doing service account testing; the identity sync usually maps your Okta group to team roles. did you run the identity sync step in the onboarding doc?
Diego M: i clicked through the SSO link but might have missed the final group consent. identity-bot: Identity sync status for diego@example.com: pending (consent required).
Ben (DevEx): that explains it. The impersonation error comes from the cluster not recognizing your user or SA mapping yet. Two options: (1) finish the identity consent so the sync adds you to `team-data`, or (2) request a personal dev namespace to iterate without team RBAC.
Diego M: if i finish the consent, how long does it take?
Sam K: usually ~5-10 minutes for the sync to propagate. i'll watch for the event. if you need immediate access, i can create `sandbox-diego` and bind the `edit` role to the `diego-sa` service account.
Diego M: that'd be great — i need to run the sample pipeline against the rl-data db emulators.
Priya R: FYI, when you merge kubeconfigs on mac, keychain entries can conflict. use `KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config:~/.kube/onboard kubectl config view --merge --flatten > /tmp/merged` then move it into place to avoid clobbering tokens.
Diego M: good tip, thanks. also, any way to validate the sync completed?
Ben (DevEx): run `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n rl-data --as=diego@example.com` after ~10m. infra emits an event too. identity-bot: Consent completed for diego@example.com, groups: [team-data].
Sam K: sync went through. i also created `sandbox-diego` and bound edit to `system:serviceaccount:default:diego-sa`. try `kubectl get ns` then `kubectl get pods -n sandbox-diego`.
Diego M: works — namespace present and `kubectl run test --image=busybox -n sandbox-diego -- sleep 3600` created a pod. thanks everyone.
Ben (DevEx): great. next steps: (1) confirm you can access team namespace after identity sync, (2) delete sandbox resources when done, (3) read the onboarding k8s section for kubeconfig merge and SA patterns: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/k8s-access.
Diego M: will do. appreciate the quick help! :party-parrot:
